decision_reason: Insufficient evidence: no detached offline snapshot supplied; no historical sweep was run.
limitations: Neutral startup allocation is a documented paper assumption.
Liquidation uses a modeled maintenance rate, not verified exchange tiers.
One-minute OHLC cannot establish actual queue fills or intraminute execution.
Scanner normalizes known funding periods to eight hours; replay requires actual eight-hour settlement records.
Historical candles alone cannot prove historical spread, depth or funding coverage.
next_input: Detached checkpointed SQLite copy outside all protected paths with snapshot.json attestation.
